purpose: Первичные источники для 03-OPEN-SOURCE-REUSE.md; ограниченный shortlist, без установки зависимостей.

evidence_policy.inspected: Pinned public source files, current upstream commit metadata, official docs and license files.
evidence_policy.runtime: No new runtime integration, native builds or performance tests performed by this research.
evidence_policy.distinction: Research snapshots are not approved dependency artifact pins. Source presence is not proof of packaged exports or app support.
evidence_policy.license: Observed file declarations, not a legal opinion; code/data/tiles/services and transitive notices are distinct.
